title: mention
description: Raw event stream — one (ticker × content_item) reference, the atomic empirical event and source of truth for all empirical features. See data-dictionary.md §2.2 and data-model.md §5.2.
x-grain: one (ticker × content_item) reference — atomic empirical event

ticker.description: Extracted, whitelist-validated symbol. Precedence: stoplist → whitelist → ambiguous-context gate → $-cashtag override.

platform.description: Denormalized from the item so SoV/momentum compute per-source and combined.

created_utc.description: Inherited event time of the item — the value that buckets the mention into a window.

flair.description: Item flair at mention time (Reddit); on Discord, carry container (channel) instead.

container.description: Discord channel at mention time (Discord); Reddit uses flair instead.

direction.description: Stance from options/position language (calls/long vs puts/short) — not ironic sentiment. null = couldn't classify.

weight.description: Per-mention ticker weight. v0.0.1 = 1.0 (binary grain). Hook for 1/n multi-ticker or primary-ticker boost later; aggregations sum weight so mentions/sov become weighted when weight≠1.
